_comment: USD per 1M tokens, first-party API list prices. This is a cache with a limited shelf life, not a source of truth — see _fetched_at/_max_age_days and the session-cost-report skill for the refresh procedure.
_caveats: session_cost.py bills cache-creation and cache-read tokens at the same input_per_mtok rate as regular input. Real cache reads are cheaper (~$0.20/MTok for opus/sonnet), so the script's estimate is conservative (slightly overstates cost), never understates it.

claude-haiku-5-5 output_per_mtok applies to prompts up to 100K tokens; beyond that it rises to $0.50 input / $2.50 output. Short subagent calls are the common case, so the base rate is the right approximation then.
